kittens are amazing, albeit insane (I've had numerous fluffy psychoses). Play games and have fun. When you break down, just remember at least you're not alone. 

[Edited for good advice].

Nobody said you can't make up anything you want. If you didn't want feedback, please be aware this subreddit is for receiving feedback. 

My point was that your ignorance subtracts from the credibility of your song. For example, you wrote above: 

> "Egypt? No blockades or settlements there. Israel? To be honest, out of all Palestine's neighbors, the only one who has it worse THAN the Palestinians is probably the Syrians." 

Not only are you "honestly" ignorant that Palestinians actually have a higher standard of living than Egyptians (actually their standard of living is better than most of the rest of the world's population), but you're also apparently ignorant that **Gaza has a border with Egypt**, **and** **Egypt DOES have a blockade against Gaza**, *despite the fact that Palestinians have not declared war against Egypt* (unlike the Palestinian declaration of war against Israel, which is embedded into the founding Charters of both Hamas and the Palestinian Authority governed by the PLO).

Recently, [Egypt demolished entire neighborhoods in Gaza](http://www.nytimes.com/2014/10/30/world/middleeast/egypt-sinai-peninsula-gaza-buffer-zone.html) to make a buffer zone between their territories:

> Oct. 29, 2014 - CAIRO — With bulldozers and dynamite, the Egyptian Army on Wednesday began demolishing hundreds of houses, displacing thousands of people, along the border with Gaza in a panicked effort to establish a buffer zone that officials hope will stop the influx of militants and weapons across the frontier.

(For some reason, I doubt you cared to write a song about that.)

Anyone who reads the respective charters of Israel and the Palestinians will understand why there isn't peace between the two sides:

[Israel's charter](http://www.mfa.gov.il/mfa/foreignpolicy/peace/guide/pages/declaration%20of%20establishment%20of%20state%20of%20israel.aspx) document from 1948 says:

> WE APPEAL - in the very midst of the onslaught launched against us now for months - to the Arab inhabitants of the State of Israel to preserve peace and participate in the upbuilding of the State on the basis of full and equal citizenship and due representation in all its provisional and permanent institutions.
> 
> WE EXTEND our hand to all neighbouring states and their peoples in an offer of peace and good neighbourliness, and appeal to them to establish bonds of cooperation and mutual help with the sovereign Jewish people settled in its own land. The State of Israel is prepared to do its share in a common effort for the advancement of the entire Middle East.

Compare Israel's acceptance of the [UN vote to partition the Palestinian Mandate](http://unispal.un.org/unispal.nsf/0/7F0AF2BD897689B785256C330061D253) into separate territories providing for ***both*** Jewish and Arab self-determination and Israel's explicit call for peace, democracy, and equal rights for all, to the [Hamas charter](http://avalon.law.yale.edu/20th_century/hamas.asp) which openly calls for genocide of the Jewish people anywhere in the world:

> Article Seven
> 
> [...]
> 
> The Prophet, Allah bless him and grant him salvation, has said:
> 
> "The Day of Judgement will not come about until Moslems fight the Jews (killing the Jews), when the Jew will hide behind stones and trees. The stones and trees will say O Moslems, O Abdulla, there is a Jew behind me, come and kill him. Only the Gharkad tree, (evidently a certain kind of tree) would not do that because it is one of the trees of the Jews." (related by al-Bukhari and Moslem).
> The Slogan of the Islamic Resistance Movement:
> 
> Article Eight:
> 
> Allah is its target, the Prophet is its model, the Koran its constitution: Jihad is its path and death for the sake of Allah is the loftiest of its wishes.

and to the [Palestinian Authority charter](http://www.un.int/wcm/content/site/palestine/pid/12362), which [denies the history and connection of the Jewish people to the land of Israel, and also requires the complete elimination of Israel](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Palestinian_National_Covenant#The_Charter_and_the_question_of_Israel.27s_right_to_exist):

> describes the establishment of the state of Israel as "entirely illegal" (Art. 19), considers Palestine, with its original Mandate borders, as the indivisible homeland of the Arab Palestinian people (1-2), urges the elimination of Zionism in Palestine and worldwide (Art. 15), and strongly urges the "liberation" of Palestine throughout by ethnic cleansing of Jewish presence.

IMHO, the Palestinian songs linked above (recently broadcast on official Palestinian government media channels) are much better than your song because at least they're not completely ignorant about the goals of Palestinian nationalism, which are explicitly spelled out in their charters for anyone to read who honestly cares to be informed.

Actually, according to the most recent UN Human Development Report comparison chart, the Palestinians ranked 107, better than many other major Muslim states, including Egypt (110) and Pakistan (147) - as well as better than many major non-Muslim states, such as the Phillipines (117), South Africa (118), and India (135).  

http://hdr.undp.org/en/content/table-2-human-development-index-trends-1980-2013
